CheckTitle: Check if EC2 Instance Metadata Service Version 2 (IMDSv2) is Enabled and Required
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/Industry and Regulatory Standards/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
Description: Checks that EC2 instances require IMDSv2 session tokens (HttpTokens=required) or have the metadata endpoint disabled.
Risk: IMDSv1 can be abused through SSRF vulnerabilities to steal the instance role's temporary credentials.

Recommendation.Text: Require IMDSv2 on all instances and set the account default to IMDSv2-only.
